resources.string: Update ready - press OK to install
Allow this app to install updates

Android blocks a sideloaded update until Family Dashboard is allowed to install unknown apps. This switch is only for updates of this app. Press OK to open that setting, turn it on, then come back and press OK again.
The settings page did not open. On the TV, open Settings, Apps, Special app access, Install unknown apps, and turn it on for Family Dashboard. Then come back and press OK.
